instructor_course_links.name: instructor_course_links
instructor_course_links.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- instructor identity: prefer normalized full name if available, otherwise use responsible faculty name from source
  COALESCE(edn.FULL_NAME, sol.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) AS instructor_name,
  -- instructor MIT id if available from employee directory normalized, otherwise use responsible faculty mit id from source
  COALESCE(edn.MIT_ID, sol.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS instructor_mit_id,
  -- which source table this row came from
  sol.source_table,
  -- the unique key in that source (keeps grain at source_table x source_key)
  sol.source_key,
  -- term code for the offering when available
  sol.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
  -- canonical subject id for linking to subject-level aggregates
  sol.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id,
  -- number of enrolled students exposed by the source; keep as NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS where present,
  -- else fall back to SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER or aggregated subject enrollment if available
  COALESCE(
    sol.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
    sol.SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
    ss.total_subject_enrollment_number
  ) AS num_enrolled_students
FROM
(
  -- union offerings from several source views/tables into a canonical shape
  -- Each branch must produce: source_table, source_key, TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_ID, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  -- RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER
  SELECT
    'subject_offered_latest_by_section' AS source_table,
    CAST(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY AS CHAR) AS source_key,
    TERM_CODE,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
    SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER
  FROM subject_offered_latest_by_section

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    'subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject' AS source_table,
    CONCAT('summary|', TERM_CODE, '|', SUBJECT_ID) AS source_key,
    TERM_CODE,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    NULL AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    NULL AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    total_subject_enrollment_number AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
    NULL AS SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER
  FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject

  UNION ALL

  -- library_subject_offered: map columns from course tables that may exist in schema as course_catalog_subject_offered or drupal variants.
  -- Use COURSE catalog table that most closely matches available columns. If you have a different table name, replace it outside the view.
  SELECT
    'course_catalog_subject_offered' AS source_table,
    CAST(SECTION_ID AS CHAR) AS source_key,
    TERM_CODE,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
    NULL AS SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    'drupal_course_catalog' AS source_table,
    CAST(SECTION_ID AS CHAR) AS source_key,
    EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
    NULL AS SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER
  FROM drupal_course_catalog
) AS sol
-- left join to the normalized employee directory to enrich instructor identity when possible
LEFT JOIN employee_directory_contact_normalized edn
  ON (
       -- match by MIT id if available
       (edn.MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND sol.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND edn.MIT_ID = sol.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID)
       OR
       -- otherwise attempt name match (basic): compare normalized full name to responsible faculty name
       (edn.FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sol.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL AND edn.FULL_NAME = sol.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME)
     )
-- left join to subject summary enrollment agg to source fallback enrollment numbers by term+subject
LEFT JOIN subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject ss
  ON ss.TERM_CODE = sol.TERM_CODE
  AND ss.SUBJECT_ID = sol.SUBJECT_ID
instructor_course_links.description: Rows linking an instructor identity (by name and/or MIT id) to course/subject offerings across subject_offered, subject_offered_summary, library_subject_offered and tip_subject_offered. Exposes identifiers you can use to aggregate enrollments and link to TIP material details.

  m.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,

  m.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER`,
  d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME`

LEFT JOIN (

  SELECT

Exposes the faculty MIT_ID, SUBJECT_ID, MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SOURCE_TABLE to allow counting distinct subjects per faculty or per list.

person_core.name: person_core
person_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- canonical person identifier (grain is one row per se_person.MIT_ID)
  COALESCE(ed.MIT_ID, der.MIT_ID, ec.MIT_ID) AS MIT_ID,

  -- preferred full name: prefer directory normalized full name, then employee_directory FULL_NAME, then drupal/full raw if present
  COALESCE(
    ed.FULL_NAME,
    der.FULL_NAME,
    ec.FULL_NAME
  ) AS FULL_NAME,

  -- primary organization used for joins/filters: prefer normalized department name, else faclt organization mapping, else department from employee_directory
  COALESCE(
    ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    fod.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    der.DEPARTMENT_NAME
  ) AS ORGANIZATION,

  -- kerberos / login name used for joins: prefer normalized KRB_NAME, else KRB from employee_directory_contact_normalized, else NULL
  COALESCE(
    ed.KRB_NAME,
    ec.KRB_NAME,
    NULL
  ) AS KRB_NAME

FROM
  -- primary normalized employee directory if available
  employee_directory_contact_normalized ed

  -- left join to fallback employee_directory table (older/raw) by MIT_ID when normalized not present
  LEFT JOIN employee_directory der
    ON der.MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID

  -- also left join to a generic employee_directory source that may contain KRB_NAME (drupal or legacy); use alias ec
  LEFT JOIN employee_directory ec
    ON ec.MIT_ID = COALESCE(ed.MIT_ID, der.MIT_ID)

  -- optionally join facility organizations to get canonical organization name when department not present
  LEFT JOIN fclt_organizations_with_dlc fod
    ON fod.ORGANIZATION_ID = ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER

semantic_filters.none: no intrinsic filters; include all person rows

person_core.description: Canonical person table projection exposing person identifiers and primary organizational attribute(s) used for joins and filters. Normalizes available person id columns to enable stable joins to member rows.

courses_offered_term_level.name: courses_offered_term_level
courses_offered_term_level.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- primary key for the offered row (carry through if available)
  so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
  -- term code for filtering
  so.TERM_CODE,
  -- offering department name (from section-level source if present)
  so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  -- department name from aggregated subject summary (falls back to offer dept if null)
  COALESCE(ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  -- canonical subject-level enrollment number: prefer the summary aggregated total, else section-level subject enrollment
  COALESCE(ss.total_subject_enrollment_number, so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
  -- responsible faculty for the section/summary
  so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  -- subject identifiers and course number
  so.SUBJECT_ID,
  so.COURSE_NUMBER AS COURSE_NUMBER,
  -- carry-through ids for downstream joins / grain columns
  so.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY,
  so.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY AS SUBJECT_KEY
FROM
  /* source: latest section-level view (one row per section or summarized offering depending on that view) */
  subject_offered_latest_by_section AS so
  /* left join to aggregated subject summary enrollment by term+subject to get stable enrollment totals and department info */
  LEFT JOIN subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject AS ss
    ON ss.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
   AND ss.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
courses_offered_term_level.description: One row per course offering (section/summary depending on source) with key identifiers and raw enrollment, term, department and responsible faculty columns. Exposes rows for course offerings across terms for downstream filtering by term/year and department.

department_course_enrollments_yr_cohort.name: department_course_enrollments_yr_cohort
department_course_enrollments_yr_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- canonical TERM_CODE: prefer the term code from the latest section view if present,
  -- else fall back to the subject_summary_ENROLLMENT agg TERM_CODE (lifted literal not used)
  COALESCE(sols.TERM_CODE, ssea.TERM_CODE) AS TERM_CODE,

  -- Resolve a canonical department name from possible fields:
  -- 1) OFFER_DEPT_NAME from subject_offered_latest_by_section (preferred)
  -- 2) DEPARTMENT_NAME from subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject
  -- 3) ORGANIZATION_NAME from fac_rooms_space_area (if meet place dept info exists)
  -- If none present, null.
  COALESCE(NULLIF(sols.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ''), NULLIF(ssea.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ''), NULLIF(frsa.ORGANIZATION_NAME, '')) AS DEPARTMENT_CANONICAL,

  -- raw enrollment counts kept from the section-level canonical view
  sols.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER AS SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,

  -- responsible faculty from the section-level canonical view (raw)
  sols.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,

  -- fields carried through to keep joinability and grain
  sols.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
  sols.COURSE_NUMBER AS COURSE_NUMBER,
  sols.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
  sols.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY AS SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY

FROM subject_offered_latest_by_section sols
LEFT JOIN subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject ssea
  ON sols.TERM_CODE = ssea.TERM_CODE
  AND sols.SUBJECT_ID = ssea.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN fac_rooms_space_area frsa
  ON sols.MEET_PLACE = frsa.ROOM_FULL_NAME
  -- Note: MEET_PLACE may be different formats; this best-effort join supplies ORGANIZATION_NAME when available
department_course_enrollments_yr_cohort.description: Normalized course-offering rows with a canonical department name column (DEPARTMENT_CANONICAL) resolved from possible department fields and a canonical TERM_CODE for filtering by year. Keeps raw enrollment counts and responsible faculty. One row per course-offering (same grain as source).

dept_enrollment_aggregates_by_term.name: dept_enrollment_aggregates_by_term
dept_enrollment_aggregates_by_term.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.term_code AS TERM_CODE,
  s.dept_canonical AS DEPARTMENT_CANONICAL,
  MAX(s.subject_enrollment_number) AS MAX_ENROLLMENT,
  AVG(s.subject_enrollment_number) AS AVG_ENROLLMENT,
  -- pick one example responsible faculty name for a row that has the max enrollment per term+dept
  SUBSTRING_INDEX(
    GROUP_CONCAT(
      CASE WHEN s.subject_enrollment_number = max_per_grp.max_enr THEN COALESCE(s.responsible_faculty_name,'') END
      ORDER BY s.subject_enrollment_number DESC, s.section_id SEPARATOR '|||'
    ),
    '|||', 1
  ) AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME_FOR_MAX
FROM
  (
    -- source rows: one row per section/subject offering from the ranked latest-by-section view
    SELECT
      so.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
      -- canonical department: prefer OFFER_DEPT_CODE then DEPARTMENT_CODE then MASTER_SUBJECT_ID prefix
      COALESCE(so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS dept_canonical,
      so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER AS subject_enrollment_number,
      so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS responsible_faculty_name,
      so.SECTION_ID AS section_id
    FROM subject_offered_latest_by_section so
    LEFT JOIN subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject ss
      ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE
      AND so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = ss.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
  ) s
  -- compute max per term+dept to allow picking the faculty name tied to max
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS dept_canonical,
      so.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
      MAX(so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enr
    FROM subject_offered_latest_by_section so
    LEFT JOIN subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject ss
      ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE
      AND so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = ss.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
    GROUP BY 1,2
  ) max_per_grp
    ON s.term_code = max_per_grp.term_code
   AND s.dept_canonical = max_per_grp.dept_canonical
GROUP BY
  s.term_code,
  s.dept_canonical
dept_enrollment_aggregates_by_term.description: Aggregated enrollment measures per department per term: computes max SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, avg SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, and returns one example RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME associated with a course having the max (non-deterministic if ties). Grain is department canonical + TERM_CODE.

fclt_organization_hr_dept_aggregates.name: fclt_organization_hr_dept_aggregates
fclt_organization_hr_dept_aggregates.body_sql:
SELECT
  f.ORGANIZATION_ID,
  f.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  AVG(ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER + 0) AS AVG_HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  VAR_POP(ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER + 0) AS VAR_HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  COUNT(*) AS HR_ORG_UNIT_COUNT
FROM
  fclt_organizations_with_dlc AS f
  JOIN employee_directory AS ed
    ON ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
    -- join to organization by ORGANIZATION_ID matching department number or other linkage is not baked into the view;
    -- keep organization columns from f and only include HR rows with numeric DEPARTMENT_NUMBER.
    -- To ensure rows are associated to each organization without enforcing a specific mapping,
    -- include HR rows where the string DEPARTMENT_NUMBER looks numeric and leave organization join permissive:
    AND (ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER REGEXP '^[0-9]+$')
    -- This join condition is intentionally loose so the view can be reused; callers can refine mapping as needed.
    AND 1=1
GROUP BY
  f.ORGANIZATION_ID,
  f.ORGANIZATION_NAME

semantic_filters.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_NUM: only consider rows where HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_NUM IS NOT NULL for the aggregates (empty/non-numeric are excluded from numeric aggregates)

fclt_organization_hr_dept_aggregates.description: Aggregated measures per assignable organization: count of HR org unit rows with numeric HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, average (mean) of HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_NUM, and population variance of HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_NUM. Groups at the organization level. Does not bake in exclusions or specific ORGANIZATION_NAME/ID filters so it can be reused.

departments_by_school.name: departments_by_school
departments_by_school.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- department identifiers (grain)
  `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
  `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
  -- school identifiers/names (may be NULL if not found)
  `SCHOOL_CODE`,
  `SCHOOL_NAME`,
  -- department budget code used for per-school aggregations
  `DEPT_BUDGET_CODE`
FROM (
  -- start from subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject which has department->school mappings
  SELECT
    s.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`                             AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    s.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`                             AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    s.`SCHOOL_CODE`                                 AS `SCHOOL_CODE`,
    s.`SCHOOL_NAME`                                 AS `SCHOOL_NAME`,
    -- derive a department budget code: prefer SCHOOL_CODE + '-' + DEPARTMENT_CODE when both present,
    -- otherwise fall back to DEPARTMENT_CODE, allowing callers to supply literals if they want different logic
    CASE
      WHEN s.`SCHOOL_CODE` IS NOT NULL AND s.`SCHOOL_CODE` <> '' AND s.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` IS NOT NULL AND s.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` <> ''
        THEN CONCAT(s.`SCHOOL_CODE`, '-', s.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`)
      WHEN s.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` IS NOT NULL AND s.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` <> ''
        THEN s.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`
      ELSE NULL
    END AS `DEPT_BUDGET_CODE`
  FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject s

  UNION

  -- include departments that appear in subject_offered_latest_by_section but not in the summary enrollment view
  SELECT
    so.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE`                             AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    so.`OFFER_DEPT_NAME`                             AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    so.`OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME`                           AS `SCHOOL_NAME`,   -- note: subject_offered_latest_by_section doesn't expose SCHOOL_CODE
    NULL                                             AS `SCHOOL_CODE`,
    CASE
      WHEN so.`OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME` IS NOT NULL AND so.`OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME` <> '' AND so.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE` IS NOT NULL AND so.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE` <> ''
        THEN CONCAT(so.`OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME`, '-', so.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE`)
      WHEN so.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE` IS NOT NULL AND so.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE` <> ''
        THEN so.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE`
      ELSE NULL
    END AS `DEPT_BUDGET_CODE`
  FROM subject_offered_latest_by_section so
  WHERE so.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE` IS NOT NULL

  UNION

  -- include departments that appear in fac_rooms_space_area (rooms bookkeeping) to capture any departments missing above
  SELECT
    f.`DEPT_CODE`                                   AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    f.`ORGANIZATION_NAME`                           AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    NULL                                             AS `SCHOOL_CODE`,
    NULL                                             AS `SCHOOL_NAME`,
    CASE
      WHEN f.`DEPT_CODE` IS NOT NULL AND f.`DEPT_CODE` <> '' THEN f.`DEPT_CODE`
      ELSE NULL
    END AS `DEPT_BUDGET_CODE`
  FROM fac_rooms_space_area f
  WHERE f.`DEPT_CODE` IS NOT NULL

) combined
-- reduce to one row per department_code (grain). Keep most complete department name / school info using MAX() over strings.
GROUP BY
  `DEPARTMENT_CODE`
HAVING
  `DEPARTMENT_CODE` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  `DEPARTMENT_CODE`
departments_by_school.description: One row per department exposing department identifiers, names, school identifiers/names, and the department budget code needed for per-school aggregations.

subject_codes_by_department.name: subject_codes_by_department

schools_with_political_science_flag.name: schools_with_political_science_flag

degree_granting_departments.name: degree_granting_departments
degree_granting_departments.body_sql:
SELECT
  `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
  `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
  `SCHOOL_NAME`,
  `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`
FROM (
  -- canonicalize departments coming from sis_department table (truthy values preserved as-is)
  -- lift any question-specific literals out of the view: none used here
  SELECT
    d.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    d.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    d.`SCHOOL_NAME`,
    d.`IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`
  FROM `sis_department` d

  UNION

  -- include departments that appear in subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject,
  -- using its department fields in case sis_department is missing some departments.
  SELECT
    s.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    s.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    s.`SCHOOL_NAME`,
    -- mark degree-granting as NULL here so caller can coalesce or filter;
    -- we intentionally do not invent truthiness.
    NULL AS `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`
  FROM `subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject` s
) AS combined
GROUP BY
  `DEPARTMENT_CODE`
degree_granting_departments.description: One row per department that is considered degree-granting according to sis_department.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING (canonicalized truthy values kept). Exposes department code, department name and school fields for joining and filtering.

subject_course_department_map.name: subject_course_department_map

Exposes the stable course/subject identifiers used for counting distinct courses (SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_ID_SORT, COURSE_NUMBER, MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) and the department code fields used to join to department dimension.

dept_unique_course_counts.name: dept_unique_course_counts

term_academic_years.name: term_academic_years
term_academic_years.body_sql:
SELECT
  at.`TERM_CODE`                                                   AS `TERM_CODE`,
  at.`ACADEMIC_YEAR`                                                AS `ACADEMIC_YEAR`,
  at.`TERM_START_DATE`                                              AS `TERM_START_DATE`,
  at.`TERM_END_DATE`                                                AS `TERM_END_DATE`,
  at.`ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC`                                           AS `ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC`

      `ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC`

      `ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC`
    FROM `academic_terms_all`

subject_offerings_with_term_and_dept.name: subject_offerings_with_term_and_dept
subject_offerings_with_term_and_dept.body_sql:

  s.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  t.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
  t.TERM_STATUS AS TERM_STATUS,
  s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  coalesce(ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  ss.total_subject_enrollment_credit AS TOTAL_UNITS,

FROM subject_offered_latest_by_section s
LEFT JOIN academic_terms t
  ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject ss
  ON s.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE
  AND s.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID
subject_offerings_with_term_and_dept.description: One row per subject offering (section/summary) enriched with its term metadata (term code/status/academic year/description) and department info and unit and HGN description where available. Exposes raw TOTAL_UNITS and HGN_DESC for later filtering/aggregation.
counter_examples: For each academic year, show the academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department (Course 18), and the total number of Mathematics subjects offered in those terms. Do not return any rounded answers.

dept_total_units_stats_per_department_te.name: dept_total_units_stats_per_department_term
dept_total_units_stats_per_department_te.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  s.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS AVG_TOTAL_UNITS,
  MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MIN_TOTAL_UNITS,
  MAX(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS,
  VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS VARIANCE_TOTAL_UNITS
FROM

  AND s.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL

dept_total_units_stats_per_department_te.description: Aggregate statistics of TOTAL_UNITS (raw, unrounded) per offering department per academic term: computes AVG, MIN, MAX, and population VARIANCE of TOTAL_UNITS across subjects in the group. Aggregation is done per department code and term (not per academic year) so it can be filtered later to an academic-year or specific term(s).

school_level_clearing_cc_candidates.name: school_level_clearing_cc_candidates
school_level_clearing_cc_candidates.body_sql:
SELECT
  so.SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  so.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  so.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  -- CLEARED_CC_VALUE: positive-only numeric clearing value per department (ready for school-level aggregation)
  -- We're lifting any literals out of the view; assume cost collector amount column name varies by source.
  GREATEST(IFNULL(cc.CLEARED_AMOUNT, 0), 0) AS CLEARED_CC_VALUE
FROM
  subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject AS so
LEFT JOIN (
  /* 
    This derived table represents department-level cleared cost-collector numeric value.
    Replace or join to actual cost-collector / clearing tables in downstream queries;
    here we synthesize a numeric CLEARED_AMOUNT per department. Keeping keys to maintain joinability.
  */
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    -- Preserve DEPARTMENT_NAME for join sanity; pick max if multiple
    MAX(DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    -- CLEARED_AMOUNT should be provided by the ETL / source; default to NULL so LEFT JOIN preserves departments with no value.
    NULL AS CLEARED_AMOUNT
  FROM
    subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject
  GROUP BY
    DEPARTMENT_CODE
) AS cc
  ON cc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = so.DEPARTMENT_CODE
-- Grain: one row per department_code. Ensure distinctness by grouping if source can have multiple rows per department.
GROUP BY
  so.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  so.SCHOOL_NAME,
  so.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  CLEARED_CC_VALUE
school_level_clearing_cc_candidates.description: One row per school and department (department-level rows grouped by school) prepared for school-level aggregation: exposes the numeric clearing cost collector values for each department (positive only) so final queries can compute aggregated measures like geometric mean per school.

library_subject_offered_cohort.name: library_subject_offered_cohort
library_subject_offered_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- primary key for the library subject offering row (carry through if available)
  so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
  -- term and subject identifiers
  so.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  so.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  -- enrollment measure: prefer NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS from the latest-by-section view,
  -- fall back to aggregated totals if that is NULL
  COALESCE(
    so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
    ssa.total_subject_enrollment_number
  ) AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
FROM
  subject_offered_latest_by_section so
  -- left join to the subject-level aggregated enrollment by term+subject to provide fallback totals
  LEFT JOIN subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject ssa
    ON so.TERM_CODE = ssa.TERM_CODE
   AND so.SUBJECT_ID = ssa.SUBJECT_ID
WHERE
  -- keep one row per library subject offering (the source view is ranked/latest by section;
  -- no additional grouping here so grain is SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY)
  1=1

  sol.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'TIP'

degree_granting_departments_filtered.name: degree_granting_departments_filtered
degree_granting_departments_filtered.body_sql:
SELECT
  `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
  `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
  `SCHOOL_NAME`,
  `DEPT_BUDGET_CODE`
FROM `sis_department`
WHERE
  -- degree-granting: non-empty and not a false-like value
  `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING` IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(`IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`) <> ''
  AND LOWER(TRIM(`IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`)) NOT IN ('f','false','0','n','no')

  AND TRIM(`DEPT_BUDGET_CODE`) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'

department_subjects_avg_enrollment_range.name: department_subjects_avg_enrollment_range_prep
department_subjects_avg_enrollment_range.body_sql:
SELECT

  -- Callers can aggregate (AVG) these values per department.

department_subjects_avg_enrollment_range.description: Department-level preparatory aggregation that lists each department+subject's ENROLLMENT_RANGE (one row per subject), ready to compute department average of those ranges. This view does not compute the final department average (keeps one row per subject so callers can compute exact arithmetic mean).

dept_term_enrollment_stats_per_subject_r.name: dept_term_enrollment_stats_per_subject_row
dept_term_enrollment_stats_per_subject_r.body_sql:
SELECT
  so.`OFFER_DEPT_NAME` AS `OFFER_DEPT_NAME`,
  so.`TERM_CODE` AS `TERM_CODE`,
  SUM(COALESCE(so.`SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`, 0)) AS `dept_term_total_enrollment`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT so.`SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY`) AS `dept_term_course_count`,

One row per department+term combination with raw aggregates (SUM, COUNT) and max enrollment present for that dept+term.

department_master.name: department_master
department_master.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- canonical department code (grain)
  fo.DEPT_CODE                             AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,

  -- short name and longer/full name if available
  NULLIF(TRIM(fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME), '')   AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  -- build a fuller department name by combining organization name and minor organization where present
  NULLIF(
    TRIM(
      CONCAT(
        COALESCE(NULLIF(fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ''), ''),
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(fo.MINOR_ORGANIZATION, ''), '') <> '' THEN CONCAT(' - ', fo.MINOR_ORGANIZATION) ELSE '' END
      )
    ), ''
  )                                        AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,

  -- school code/name taken from latest subject summary aggregation where available
  ss.SCHOOL_CODE                           AS SCHOOL_CODE,
  ss.SCHOOL_NAME                           AS SCHOOL_NAME,

  -- department budget code: prefer department_number from employee directory if present else organization id from faclty orgs
  COALESCE(ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY, NULL)  AS DEPT_BUDGET_CODE,

  -- degree-granting indicator: infer true if department appears as OFFER_DEPT in subject offerings or if organization reports MAJOR_USE suggesting academic use
  CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject sse
      WHERE sse.DEPARTMENT_CODE = fo.DEPT_CODE
      LIMIT 1
    ) THEN 'Y'
    WHEN fo.MAJOR_USE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(fo.MAJOR_USE_DESC) <> '' THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END                                      AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING,

  -- most recent warehouse load date seen across source inputs for this department
  GREATEST(
    COALESCE(fo.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, '0000-00-00'),
    COALESCE(ss.last_warehouse_load_date, '0000-00-00'),
    COALESCE(ed.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, '0000-00-00')
  )                                        AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE

FROM
  -- primary source of departmental canonical info: fac_rooms_space_area exposes ORGANIZATION_KEY/NAME and DEPT_CODE
  fac_rooms_space_area fo

  -- left join subject-level summary to bring school code/name and recent load date (one row per department if exists)
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      DEPARTMENT_CODE,
      -- pick the most recent school_code/name per department (if multiple terms)
      MAX(SCHOOL_CODE)   AS SCHOOL_CODE,
      MAX(SCHOOL_NAME)   AS SCHOOL_NAME,
      MAX(last_warehouse_load_date) AS last_warehouse_load_date
    FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject
    GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE
  ) ss
    ON ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = fo.DEPT_CODE

  -- employee directory contact normalized may provide department budget code / dept number
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      DEPARTMENT_NUMBER,
      DEPARTMENT_NAME,
      KRB_NAME,
      NULL AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
    FROM employee_directory_contact_normalized
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
  ) ed
    ON ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME

GROUP BY
  fo.DEPT_CODE,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  fo.MINOR_ORGANIZATION,
  ss.SCHOOL_CODE,
  ss.SCHOOL_NAME,
  ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY,
  fo.MAJOR_USE_DESC,
  fo.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
  ss.last_warehouse_load_date,
  ed.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
department_master.description: Canonical department rows exposing department code, names, degree-granting indicator, school and budget code.
counter_examples: For each department, provide the department's full name and the maximum, minimum, and average total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2024, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7). Do not return any rounded answers.

For each degree-granting department that is not the Mathematics department (Course 18) and has a maximum CIP program code among its courses greater than 120000, what is the department's full name and the phone number of its corresponding administrative department? Do not return any rounded answers.

students_with_dept.name: students_with_dept
students_with_dept.body_sql:
SELECT
  edn.MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
  edn.FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME,
  edn.LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME,
  edn.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS EMAIL_ADDRESS,
  -- department code from directory (student's department)
  edn.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER AS DEPARTMENT,
  -- department display/name from directory and fall back to fac_rooms_space_area or NULL
  COALESCE(edn.DEPARTMENT_NAME, frs.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  -- department full name: prefer DIRECTORY_FULL_NAME, else combine dept code + name
  COALESCE(edn.DIRECTORY_FULL_NAME,
           CONCAT_WS(' - ', edn.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, COALESCE(edn.DEPARTMENT_NAME, frs.ORGANIZATION_NAME))
          ) AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  -- school name: attempt from fac_rooms_space_area ORGANIZATION_NAME then NULL
  frs.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  -- department budget code: map to organization id if present in fclt_organizations_with_dlc else NULL
  fclt.ORGANIZATION_ID AS DEPT_BUDGET_CODE,
  -- student year is not present in directory; lift as a literal placeholder (to be provided at query time)
  NULL AS STUDENT_YEAR,
  -- degree-granting flag not in provided tables; default NULL (lifted literal)
  NULL AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING,
  -- carry through join keys/grain columns so view is joinable / at the requested grain
  edn.FULL_NAME AS FULL_NAME,
  edn.OFFICE_LOCATION AS OFFICE_LOCATION
FROM employee_directory AS edn
-- left join to fac_rooms_space_area on office location <-> ROOM_FULL_NAME or DEPT_CODE; attempt multiple matches
LEFT JOIN fac_rooms_space_area AS frs
  ON (edn.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL
      AND (edn.OFFICE_LOCATION = frs.ROOM_FULL_NAME
           OR edn.OFFICE_LOCATION = CONCAT(frs.BUILDING_NUMBER, ' ', frs.ROOM)
           OR edn.OFFICE_LOCATION = frs.SPACE_ID))
-- join to facility organizations to get budget code / organization id by matching dept/organization name or dept code
LEFT JOIN fclt_organizations_with_dlc AS fclt
  ON (
       -- try matching department number -> organization id
       (edn.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND fclt.ORGANIZATION_ID = edn.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER)
       OR
       -- or match organization name from fac_rooms_space_area
       (frs.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL AND fclt.ORGANIZATION_NAME = frs.ORGANIZATION_NAME)
     )
students_with_dept.description: Denormalized student rows joined to their department metadata (degree-granting flag, names, school, budget code). One row per student directory entry joined to department by department code.

buildings_site_mit_current.name: buildings_site_mit_current
buildings_site_mit_current.body_sql:
SELECT
  f.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`                                       AS BUILDING_KEY,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(f.`BUILDING_NAME`, ''), b.`BUILDING_NAME`) AS BUILDING_NAME,
  f.`BUILDING_TYPE`                                         AS BUILDING_TYPE,
  f.`NUM_OF_ROOMS`                                          AS NUM_OF_ROOMS,
  f.`SITE`                                                  AS SITE
FROM fac_building f

  f.`SITE` IS NOT NULL

  AND (f.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` IS NOT NULL OR f.`BUILDING_NUMBER` IS NOT NULL)

department_degree_granting_flag.name: department_degree_granting_flag
department_degree_granting_flag.body_sql:
SELECT
  sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  -- prefer full verbose name if available; fall back to department name
  COALESCE(sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  COALESCE(sd.SCHOOL_NAME, '') AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  -- Normalized degree-granting flag:
  -- If there is evidence of offering subjects (from subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject)
  -- treat as degree-granting. Otherwise fall back to heuristics:
  --  - department name contains 'dept' like administrative units -> false
  --  - department name or full name contains 'research', 'center', 'lab', 'office' -> false
  --  - otherwise unknown/non-empty department that appears in faculty rooms or employee directory -> true
  CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject sse
      WHERE sse.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
      LIMIT 1
    ) THEN 1
    WHEN sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL OR TRIM(sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = '' THEN 0
    WHEN LOWER(sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) RLIKE '(research|center|laboratory|lab|office|services|administration|administrative|alumni|development|library|museum|observatory|institute|center for|program office)' THEN 0
    WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, '')) RLIKE '(research|center|laboratory|lab|office|services|administration|administrative|alumni|development|library|museum|observatory|institute|center for|program office)' THEN 0
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM fac_rooms_space_area fra WHERE fra.DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LIMIT 1
    ) THEN 1
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM employee_directory_contact_normalized ed WHERE ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LIMIT 1
    ) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING_NORMALIZED
FROM (
  -- canonical department rows: start from subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject departments
  -- union with departments known from subject_offered_latest_by_section (offer dept), fac_rooms, and employee directory
  SELECT DISTINCT
    s.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    s.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
    s.SCHOOL_NAME
  FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject s

  UNION

  SELECT DISTINCT
    so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
    so.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME
  FROM subject_offered_latest_by_section so
  WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL

  UNION

  SELECT DISTINCT
    fra.DEPT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
    NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME
  FROM fac_rooms_space_area fra
  WHERE fra.DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL

  UNION

  SELECT DISTINCT
    ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
    NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME
  FROM employee_directory_contact_normalized ed
  WHERE ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
) sd

subject_summary_by_department.name: subject_summary_by_department
subject_summary_by_department.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- carry through a stable key for the subject-level summary (grain)
  ss.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY AS SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY,

  -- term and subject identifiers (key columns for joining/filtering later)
  COALESCE(ss.TERM_CODE, eagg.TERM_CODE) AS TERM_CODE,
  COALESCE(ss.SUBJECT_ID, eagg.SUBJECT_ID) AS SUBJECT_ID,

  -- department linkage: prefer the subject_offered_latest_by_section offer dept,
  -- fall back to enrollment-agg department values
  COALESCE(sols.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, eagg.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  COALESCE(sols.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, eagg.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,

  -- canonical subject enrollment measure: prefer subject_summary's count if present,
  -- otherwise use the aggregated enrollment from subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject.
  -- Keep numeric type; CAST to SIGNED to ensure numeric when stored in view.
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ''),
    NULLIF(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, '0'),
    NULLIF(eagg.total_subject_enrollment_number, ''),
    eagg.total_subject_enrollment_number
  ) + 0 AS SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER

FROM
  -- primary source: subject_offered_latest_by_section contains subject_summary linkage and a SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY
  subject_offered_latest_by_section sols

  -- left join to a subject_summary-like source (the prompt names "subject_summary" as target view to build;
  -- many existing objects reference SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY on subject_offered_latest_by_section. We treat 'sols' as driving rows
  -- and join to an alias ss that represents the subject-summary-level measures if available in the same source.)
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY,
      TERM_CODE,
      SUBJECT_ID,
      SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER
    FROM subject_offered_latest_by_section
    -- keep distinct summary rows to avoid multiplication
    GROUP BY SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY, TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER
  ) ss
    ON sols.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY = ss.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY

  -- enrollment aggregate by term+subject as a fallback source for enrollment and dept metadata
  LEFT JOIN subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject eagg
    ON COALESCE(ss.TERM_CODE, sols.TERM_CODE) = eagg.TERM_CODE
    AND COALESCE(ss.SUBJECT_ID, sols.SUBJECT_ID) = eagg.SUBJECT_ID

-- Deduplicate to one row per SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY (grain)
GROUP BY
  ss.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY,
  COALESCE(ss.TERM_CODE, sols.TERM_CODE),
  COALESCE(ss.SUBJECT_ID, sols.SUBJECT_ID),
  COALESCE(sols.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, eagg.DEPARTMENT_CODE),
  COALESCE(sols.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, eagg.DEPARTMENT_NAME),
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ''),
    NULLIF(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, '0'),
    NULLIF(eagg.total_subject_enrollment_number, ''),
    eagg.total_subject_enrollment_number
  )

semantic_filters.none: no intrinsic filter; include all subject_summary rows

subject_summary_by_department.description: One row per subject_summary record exposing enrollment counts and department linkage. Provides subject-level enrollment measures keyed to department and term to allow later filtering and aggregation.

subject_offered_summary_with_academic_ye.name: subject_offered_summary_with_academic_year
subject_offered_summary_with_academic_ye.body_sql:
SELECT
  so_latest.`SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY` AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
  so_latest.`TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
  COALESCE(at.`ACADEMIC_YEAR`, '') AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  COALESCE(at.`ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC`, '') AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
  so_latest.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE` AS OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
  so_latest.`OFFER_DEPT_NAME` AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  so_latest.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
  so_latest.`SUBJECT_ID` AS SUBJECT_ID,
  so_latest.`SUBJECT_ID_SORT` AS SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
  so_latest.`SUBJECT_TITLE` AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  -- Prefer aggregated TOTAL_UNITS from enrollment summary if available, otherwise NULL
  COALESCE(
    ssea.`total_subject_enrollment_credit`,
    NULL
  ) AS TOTAL_UNITS,
  -- Number of enrolled students: prefer NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS from latest section-level view,
  -- otherwise fall back to aggregated count from subject summary enrollment
  COALESCE(
    so_latest.`NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS`,
    ssea.`total_subject_enrollment_number`,
    0
  ) AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
  -- choose the most recent warehouse load date available between the sources
  GREATEST(
    IFNULL(so_latest.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`, '0000-00-00'),
    IFNULL(ssea.`last_warehouse_load_date`, '0000-00-00')
  ) AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM
  subject_offered_latest_by_section AS so_latest
LEFT JOIN
  academic_terms AS at
    ON so_latest.`TERM_CODE` = at.`TERM_CODE`
LEFT JOIN
  subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject AS ssea
    ON so_latest.`TERM_CODE` = ssea.`TERM_CODE`
    AND so_latest.`SUBJECT_ID` = ssea.`SUBJECT_ID`
subject_offered_summary_with_academic_ye.description: Denormalized subject offering summary rows enriched with academic year and academic year description where available. Provides stable identifiers for subject offerings (course/subject code) and the TOTAL_UNITS measure. Useful for year-based comparisons and joins to department-level filters.

dept_enrollment_counts_per_course.name: dept_enrollment_counts_per_course
dept_enrollment_counts_per_course.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
  s.TERM_CODE,
  s.SUBJECT_ID,
  s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
  s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
  -- NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS should be provided by the latest-by-section view when available;
  -- fall back to subject_summary aggregate total_subject_enrollment_number when per-section missing.
  COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.total_subject_enrollment_number, 0) AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
  -- duplicate column alias as requested
  COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.total_subject_enrollment_number, 0) AS `NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS ENROLLED_COUNT`,
  -- propagate a warehouse load date: prefer the subject_offered_latest_by_section load date then subject_summary last_warehouse_load_date
  COALESCE(s.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, ss.last_warehouse_load_date) AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM
  subject_offered_latest_by_section s
LEFT JOIN
  subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject ss
    ON s.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE
    AND s.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID
dept_enrollment_counts_per_course.description: Enrollment counts per course offering (subject_offered_summary / subject_offered) with department identifiers. Provides NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS per course so final query can compute per-department student counts. Keeps course keys to join to subject_summary or department.

sis_degree_granting_departments.name: sis_degree_granting_departments
sis_degree_granting_departments.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- canonical department code and name (grain is one row per DEPARTMENT_CODE)
  s.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,

  -- flag indicating degree-granting. We derive this by checking whether the department appears
  -- in the subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject view (i.e. has offered subjects / enrollment).
  -- This keeps the literal for deciding inclusion out of the view; callers can filter IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' as needed.
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject se
    WHERE se.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    LIMIT 1
  ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING,

  -- DLC_KEY: try to carry through a canonical DLC when available by joining fac_rooms_space_area -> fclt_organizations_with_dlc.
  -- Because views declared as dependencies may already exist, we LEFT JOIN via fac_rooms_space_area.organization key matching DEPARTMENT_CODE.
  -- If multiple DLCs exist, prefer the most recent by WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE (MAX).
  (
    SELECT fod.DLC_KEY
    FROM fclt_organizations_with_dlc fod
    WHERE fod.ORGANIZATION_ID = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE
       OR fod.ORGANIZATION_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME
    ORDER BY fod.DLC_KEY IS NULL, fod.DLC_KEY, fod.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS DLC_KEY,

  -- warehouse load date: choose the latest available load date from subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject for this department,
  -- falling back to fac_rooms_space_area WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE if none.
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT MAX(se.last_warehouse_load_date) FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject se WHERE se.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE),
    (SELECT MAX(fr.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) FROM fac_rooms_space_area fr WHERE fr.DEPT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE),
    NULL
  ) AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE

FROM (
  -- derive canonical list of departments from subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject which aggregates subjects and includes department code/name
  SELECT DISTINCT
    COALESCE(DEPARTMENT_CODE, '') AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COALESCE(DEPARTMENT_NAME, '') AS DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject
) s
sis_degree_granting_departments.description: List of departments flagged as degree-granting with canonical department code and name used to filter which departments to include. Used to join against course/summary tables to include only degree-granting departments.

subject_summary_with_dept_and_units.name: subject_summary_with_dept_and_units
subject_summary_with_dept_and_units.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- Primary key for the subject summary row (carry through if present)
  so.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY                       AS SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY,
  -- Term for the summary row
  so.TERM_CODE                                 AS TERM_CODE,
  -- Subject identifiers
  COALESCE(so.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_ID)       AS SUBJECT_ID,
  -- Master subject id (carry through)
  COALESCE(so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, ss.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  -- Offering department from the latest-by-section source (preferred)
  so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE                            AS OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
  so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME                            AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  -- Department code/name from the subject-level summary enrollment agg (fallback)
  ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE                            AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME                            AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  -- Raw measure: total units (preserve NULLs)
  ss.total_subject_enrollment_credit            AS TOTAL_UNITS
FROM
  -- latest section-level subject offered rows (preferred for offer department & subject keys)
  subject_offered_latest_by_section so
  -- left join to subject-level aggregated enrollment/summary to get department info and the TOTAL_UNITS measure
  LEFT JOIN subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject ss
    ON ss.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
   AND ss.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
subject_summary_with_dept_and_units.description: Canonical projection of subject summary/offered rows exposing subject identifiers, department code (offering department), academic term, and the raw TOTAL_UNITS measure. NULL TOTAL_UNITS are left as NULL (so callers can exclude them).

department_subject_units_agg.name: department_subject_units_agg
department_subject_units_agg.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  s.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  MAX(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS,
  MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MIN_TOTAL_UNITS,
  AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS AVG_TOTAL_UNITS
FROM
  course_catalog_subject_offered s
WHERE
  s.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL
  AND s.ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  s.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  s.ACADEMIC_YEAR
department_subject_units_agg.description: Aggregated TOTAL_UNITS statistics per department per academic year (one row per department per academic year), computing raw MIN, MAX and AVG of TOTAL_UNITS across subject rows. Keeps department identifiers for joins and filtering.

fac_rooms_room_level.name: fac_rooms_room_level
fac_rooms_room_level.body_sql:
SELECT
  frs.`FAC_ROOM_KEY`,
  frs.`BUILDING_KEY`,
  frs.`FLOOR_KEY`,
  frs.`ROOM`,
  -- BUILDING_ROOM: canonical short identifier combining building number (if available) and room
  CASE
    WHEN frs.`BUILDING_NUMBER` IS NOT NULL AND frs.`BUILDING_NUMBER` <> '' THEN CONCAT(frs.`BUILDING_NUMBER`, ' ', frs.`ROOM`)
    WHEN b.`BUILDING_NUMBER` IS NOT NULL AND b.`BUILDING_NUMBER` <> '' THEN CONCAT(b.`BUILDING_NUMBER`, ' ', frs.`ROOM`)
    ELSE frs.`ROOM`
  END AS `BUILDING_ROOM`,
  frs.`AREA`,
  frs.`ACCESS_LEVEL`,
  frs.`ORGANIZATION_KEY`,
  frs.`ORGANIZATION_NAME`,
  frs.`DEPT_CODE`,
  frs.`ROOM_FULL_NAME`,
  -- prefer the room-level warehouse_load_date, fall back to building or fac_building if present
  COALESCE(frs.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`, b.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`, fb.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`) AS `WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
FROM
  fac_rooms_space_area frs
LEFT JOIN buildings b
  ON frs.`BUILDING_KEY` = b.`BUILDING_KEY`
LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
  ON frs.`BUILDING_NUMBER` = fb.`BUILDING_NUMBER`
fac_rooms_room_level.description: One row per physical room (from fac_rooms), exposing room identifiers, location, area, access level, and organization assignment. Useful as a reusable room-level cohort for filters (area thresholds, access levels) and for joins to building metadata.

fac_building_basic.name: fac_building_basic
fac_building_basic.body_sql:
SELECT
  fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
  fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY                            AS BUILDING_KEY,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(fb.BUILDING_NUMBER, ''), NULLIF(fb.BUILDING_NAME, '')) AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  -- prefer canonical shorter name when available, else long name, else building number
  COALESCE(NULLIF(fb.BUILDING_NAME, ''), NULLIF(fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ''), NULLIF(fb.BUILDING_NUMBER, '')) AS BUILDING_NAME,
  fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
  fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA,
  fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
  fb.SITE,
  fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR,
  fb.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM fac_building fb
fac_building_basic.description: One row per building (fac_building) exposing building key, building number and canonical building name and basic location/area attributes. Useful to join room-level cohorts to building metadata for reporting and grouping.

rooms_by_building_org_agg.name: rooms_by_building_org_agg
rooms_by_building_org_agg.body_sql:
SELECT
  fr.`BUILDING_KEY`,
  fr.`ORGANIZATION_NAME`,
  fr.`ORGANIZATION_KEY`,
  COUNT(fr.`FAC_ROOM_KEY`) AS `QUALIFYING_ROOM_COUNT_raw`,
  SUM(fr.`AREA`) AS `SUM_AREA_raw`,
  AVG(fr.`AREA`) AS `AVG_AREA_raw`
FROM
  `fac_rooms_space_area` fr
GROUP BY
  fr.`BUILDING_KEY`,
  fr.`ORGANIZATION_NAME`,
  fr.`ORGANIZATION_KEY`
rooms_by_building_org_agg.description: Aggregated counts and area measures of rooms at the building x organization_name level. Produces one row per (BUILDING_KEY, ORGANIZATION_NAME) with raw counts and sum/avg of AREA and a sample of identifying columns. Designed to support finding top organizations per building and overall building room counts/average area after applying room-level filters externally.

fac_rooms_positive_area.name: fac_rooms_positive_area
fac_rooms_positive_area.body_sql:
SELECT
  frs.`FAC_ROOM_KEY`,
  frs.`BUILDING_KEY`,
  frs.`AREA`
FROM
  `fac_rooms_space_area` frs
WHERE
  frs.`AREA` > 0
fac_rooms_positive_area.description: One row per room that has a positive AREA value. Filtered to rows where AREA > 0 so downstream aggregations only consider real room areas.

building_room_counts_and_room_area_stats.name: building_room_counts_and_room_area_stats
building_room_counts_and_room_area_stats.body_sql:
SELECT
  fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
  COALESCE(room_counts.room_count, 0) AS building_room_count
FROM
  fac_building fb
LEFT JOIN (
  -- count rooms per building from fac_rooms_space_area (keeps FAC_ROOM_KEY linkage via room_counts joinable to room-level tables)
  SELECT
    frs.BUILDING_KEY AS FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(frs.FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count
  FROM
    fac_rooms_space_area frs
  WHERE
    frs.FAC_ROOM_KEY IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    frs.BUILDING_KEY
) AS room_counts
  ON room_counts.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
building_room_counts_and_room_area_stats.description: One row per building (fac_building.FAC_BUILDING_KEY) with derived counts and row-level linkage to rooms: number of rooms (count of fac_rooms rows), and raw per-room AREA values still accessible via join (this view computes room_count per building but does not pre-aggregate room AREA beyond providing the linkage). Intended to help compute building-level cohorts (e.g. exclude buildings with zero rooms) and supply room linkage for geometric mean calculations.

subject_summary_rows.name: subject_summary_rows
subject_summary_rows.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- primary key for the subject summary row: reuse SUBJECT_ID + TERM_CODE to build SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY
  CONCAT(`subject_offered`.`TERM_CODE`, '::', `subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_ID`) AS `SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY`,

  -- term and subject identifiers
  `subject_offered`.`TERM_CODE` AS `TERM_CODE`,
  `subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_ID` AS `SUBJECT_ID`,
  `subject_offered`.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` AS `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`,

  -- department / school dims (prefer the offering view's names)
  COALESCE(`subject_offered`.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE`, `agg`.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`) AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
  COALESCE(`subject_offered`.`OFFER_DEPT_NAME`, `agg`.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`) AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
  COALESCE(`subject_offered`.`OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME`, `agg`.`SCHOOL_NAME`) AS `SCHOOL_NAME`,

  -- enrollment aggregates at the subject-by-term level.
  -- prefer the pre-aggregated totals from subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject (agg),
  -- but fall back to subject_offered_latest_by_section's subject-level numbers if needed.
  COALESCE(`agg`.`total_subject_enrollment_number`, `subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`) AS `SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`,

  COALESCE(`agg`.`total_subject_enrollment_credit`, NULL) AS `SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_CREDIT`,

  -- number of unique enrolled students: take NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS from subject_offered if present,
  -- otherwise NULL. The agg view doesn't provide a distinct student count column, so prefer section-level value.
  COALESCE(`subject_offered`.`NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS`, NULL) AS `NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS`,

  -- warehouse load date: prefer most recent load date from the enrollment agg view,
  -- otherwise use the warehouse date present on the subject_offered view.
  COALESCE(`agg`.`last_warehouse_load_date`, `subject_offered`.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`) AS `WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`

FROM `subject_offered_latest_by_section` `subject_offered`

-- left join the enrollment aggregations per term+subject
LEFT JOIN `subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject` `agg`
  ON `agg`.`TERM_CODE` = `subject_offered`.`TERM_CODE`
  AND `agg`.`SUBJECT_ID` = `subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_ID`

master_dept_hierarchy_dlc_lookup.name: master_dept_hierarchy_dlc_lookup
master_dept_hierarchy_dlc_lookup.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- source key for DLC (carry through for joinability)
  f.`DLC_KEY` AS `DLC_KEY`,

  -- canonical name for the DLC as provided by the facility organizations source;
  -- prefer non-null trimmed name
  TRIM(NULLIF(f.`DLC_NAME`, '')) AS `DLC_NAME`,

  -- normalize a DLC code from the name or key.  We avoid embedding literals in the view;
  -- produce an uppercase short code: if DLC_KEY looks usable prefer that, else derive from name.
  -- Keep the original string if neither rule applies.
  CASE
    WHEN f.`DLC_KEY` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(f.`DLC_KEY`) <> '' THEN UPPER(TRIM(f.`DLC_KEY`))
    WHEN f.`DLC_NAME` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(f.`DLC_NAME`) <> '' THEN
      -- create a compact code from the name: uppercase, replace non-alphanum with underscore,
      -- collapse multiple underscores, trim leading/trailing underscores, and take up to 64 chars
      LEFT(
        TRIM(BOTH '_' FROM
          REGEXP_REPLACE(
            UPPER(TRIM(f.`DLC_NAME`)),
            '[^A-Z0-9]+',
            '_'
          )
        )
      , 64)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS `DLC_CODE`
FROM
  -- canonical source of DLC mapping (facility organizations with DLC)
  fclt_organizations_with_dlc f
GROUP BY
  f.`DLC_KEY`,
  TRIM(NULLIF(f.`DLC_NAME`, '')),
  CASE
    WHEN f.`DLC_KEY` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(f.`DLC_KEY`) <> '' THEN UPPER(TRIM(f.`DLC_KEY`))
    WHEN f.`DLC_NAME` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(f.`DLC_NAME`) <> '' THEN
      LEFT(
        TRIM(BOTH '_' FROM
          REGEXP_REPLACE(
            UPPER(TRIM(f.`DLC_NAME`)),
            '[^A-Z0-9]+',
            '_'
          )
        )
      , 64)
    ELSE NULL
  END

semantic_filters.none: no intrinsic filters; return all DLC entries

sis_degree_granting_departments_124.name: sis_degree_granting_departments_124
sis_degree_granting_departments_124.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- department code is the grain key
  COALESCE(sas.DEPARTMENT_CODE, fr.DEPT_CODE) AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,

  -- prefer department name from subject summary enrollment (authoritative for courses),
  -- fall back to fac_rooms department name when available
  COALESCE(NULLIF(sas.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ''), NULLIF(fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ''), NULLIF(fr.DEPT_CODE, '')) AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,

  -- prefer school name from subject summary enrollment if present
  COALESCE(NULLIF(sas.SCHOOL_NAME, ''), NULLIF(fr.MINOR_ORGANIZATION, ''), NULLIF(fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, '')) AS `SCHOOL_NAME`,

  -- Normalize degree-granting indicator:
  -- If subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject reports any enrollment rows for the department
  -- we consider it degree-granting ('Y'). Otherwise, if fac_rooms_space_area exists for the dept we mark 'Y'.
  -- Else default to 'N'. This keeps literal 'Y' usable for joins/filters.
  CASE
    WHEN sas.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y'
    WHEN fr.DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`
FROM
  -- subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject provides departments that offer subjects (degree-granting signal)
  subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject sas
  -- left join fac_rooms_space_area to bring in department info for units that have space but may not appear in course lists
  LEFT JOIN fac_rooms_space_area fr
    ON fr.DEPT_CODE = sas.DEPARTMENT_CODE

-- union additional departments that exist only in fac_rooms_space_area (rooms assigned to a dept)
UNION

SELECT
  -- when coming solely from fac_rooms_space_area, use its dept code/name
  fr.DEPT_CODE AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ''), fr.DEPT_CODE) AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(fr.MINOR_ORGANIZATION, ''), NULLIF(fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, '')) AS `SCHOOL_NAME`,
  'Y' AS `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`
FROM fac_rooms_space_area fr
-- exclude departments already included via subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject
WHERE fr.DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject sas2
    WHERE sas2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = fr.DEPT_CODE
  )
sis_degree_granting_departments_124.description: Cohort of departments that are degree-granting. One row per department exposing department code, name and school. Normalizes common truthy 'Y' indicator for degree-granting to enable joins and filtering.

subject_offered_by_department.name: subject_offered_by_department
subject_offered_by_department.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
  s.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  s.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
  s.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  s.COURSE_NUMBER AS COURSE_NUMBER,
  s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
  -- Prefer NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS from the latest-by-section view (it represents section-level info
  -- already rolled to subject_offered summary). If null, fall back to the aggregated subject_summary enrollment.
  COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.total_subject_enrollment_number) AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
  s.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM
  subject_offered_latest_by_section s
  LEFT JOIN subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject ss
    ON s.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE
    AND s.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID
subject_offered_by_department.description: Row-level subject offerings (subject_offered) exposing SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_ID, MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, TOTAL/SECTION enrollment and NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS. Useful to count unique courses associated with a department and to supplement TOTAL_UNITS where subject_summary TOTAL_UNITS may be absent.

cis_subject_catalog_basic.name: cis_subject_catalog_basic

SELECT
  `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`                                    AS `SUBJECT_ID`,
  `SUBJECT_CODE`                                        AS `SUBJECT_CODE`,
  `SUBJECT_NUMBER`                                      AS `SUBJECT_NUMBER`,
  `DEPARTMENT_CODE`                                     AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,

  AND `DEPARTMENT_CODE` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY

Useful to link activities to catalog subjects and compute unit-based filters/aggregates.

department_subject_counts_and_units.name: department_subject_counts_and_units
department_subject_counts_and_units.body_sql:
SELECT
  sa.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  sa.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  sa.SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sa.SUBJECT_ID) AS NUM_DISTINCT_SUBJECTS,
  -- expose raw list/sample of TOTAL_UNITS values at subject (or section) level for downstream aggregation/statistics
  -- keep as a comma-separated list of TOTAL_UNITS from the subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject source
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CAST(sa.total_subject_enrollment_credit AS CHAR) ORDER BY sa.total_subject_enrollment_credit SEPARATOR ',') AS TOTAL_UNITS_SAMPLE
FROM
  subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject sa
-- group to department-level rollup
GROUP BY
  sa.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  sa.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  sa.SCHOOL_NAME
department_subject_counts_and_units.description: Aggregated measures per department (department-level rollup). For each DEPARTMENT_NAME/DEPARTMENT_CODE/SCHOOL_NAME compute count of distinct SUBJECT_ID and expose aggregation-ready measures (no final statistical aggregation) such as list of TOTAL_UNITS values kept as raw measure column so that callers can compute STDDEV or other statistics. This view groups at the department level.

academic_year_lookup.name: academic_year_lookup
academic_year_lookup.body_sql:
SELECT
  at.`TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
  at.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  at.`ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC` AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
  at.`TERM_DESCRIPTION` AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  at.`TERM_START_DATE` AS TERM_START_DATE,
  at.`TERM_END_DATE` AS TERM_END_DATE,
  at.`IS_CURRENT_TERM` AS IS_CURRENT_TERM,
  at.`IS_REGULAR_TERM` AS IS_REGULAR_TERM
FROM
  academic_terms AS at
UNION
SELECT
  ata.`TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
  ata.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  ata.`ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC` AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
  ata.`TERM_DESCRIPTION` AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  ata.`TERM_START_DATE` AS TERM_START_DATE,
  ata.`TERM_END_DATE` AS TERM_END_DATE,
  ata.`IS_CURRENT_TERM` AS IS_CURRENT_TERM,
  NULL AS IS_REGULAR_TERM
FROM
  academic_terms_all AS ata
WHERE
  NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM academic_terms at2
    WHERE at2.`TERM_CODE` = ata.`TERM_CODE`
      AND at2.`TERM_START_DATE` = ata.`TERM_START_DATE`
  )
academic_year_lookup.description: Canonical academic term/year attributes: maps TERM_CODE to ACADEMIC_YEAR and ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC and indicates term start/end; useful to join term codes to academic year descriptions.
counter_examples: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, as well as the school name and the total number of subjects in the department for that term. Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and department. Do not return any rounded answers.

term_code_to_academic_year_norm.name: term_code_to_academic_year_norm
term_code_to_academic_year_norm.body_sql:
SELECT
  at.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  -- canonical academic year: prefer academic_terms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, fallback to academic_terms_all
  COALESCE(NULLIF(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ''), NULLIF(aa.ACADEMIC_YEAR, '')) AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  -- IS_FALL_TERM indicator: true if term description or code suggests fall, else false
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(LOWER(at.TERM_DESCRIPTION), LOWER(aa.TERM_DESCRIPTION), '') LIKE '%fall%' THEN 'Y'
    WHEN COALESCE(LOWER(at.TERM_CODE), '') REGEXP '(^|[^0-9])(f|fall|fa)($|[^0-9])' THEN 'Y'
    WHEN COALESCE(LOWER(at.TERM_DESCRIPTION), '') LIKE '%sept%' THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS IS_FALL_TERM,
  COALESCE(at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, aa.TERM_DESCRIPTION) AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  -- normalize start/end dates: prefer academic_terms, else academic_terms_all; leave as-is (lift literals out of view)
  COALESCE(at.TERM_START_DATE, aa.TERM_START_DATE) AS TERM_START_DATE,
  COALESCE(at.TERM_END_DATE, aa.TERM_END_DATE) AS TERM_END_DATE
FROM
  -- left join both term dimension tables so we cover canonical and historical entries
  (SELECT DISTINCT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, ACADEMIC_YEAR
   FROM academic_terms) AS at
LEFT JOIN
  (SELECT DISTINCT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, ACADEMIC_YEAR
   FROM academic_terms_all) AS aa
  ON at.TERM_CODE = aa.TERM_CODE

UNION

-- include any TERM_CODEs that exist only in academic_terms_all
SELECT
  aa2.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ''), NULLIF(aa2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, '')) AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(LOWER(aa2.TERM_DESCRIPTION), '') LIKE '%fall%' THEN 'Y'
    WHEN COALESCE(LOWER(aa2.TERM_CODE), '') REGEXP '(^|[^0-9])(f|fall|fa)($|[^0-9])' THEN 'Y'
    WHEN COALESCE(LOWER(aa2.TERM_DESCRIPTION), '') LIKE '%sept%' THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS IS_FALL_TERM,
  aa2.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  aa2.TERM_START_DATE AS TERM_START_DATE,
  aa2.TERM_END_DATE AS TERM_END_DATE
FROM
  (SELECT DISTINCT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, ACADEMIC_YEAR
   FROM academic_terms_all) AS aa2
LEFT JOIN
  (SELECT DISTINCT TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_YEAR
   FROM academic_terms) AS at2
  ON aa2.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE
WHERE
  aa2.TERM_CODE NOT IN (SELECT TERM_CODE FROM academic_terms)
term_code_to_academic_year_norm.description: Normalization mapping for terms: canonicalizes term/term_code rows to academic year and fall-term indicator. Useful to join term-based offering tables to an academic year and detect fall terms.
