Exposes both organization identifiers and the HR unit identifiers/titles to support aggregations per organization + HR unit. Does not aggregate values.

space_detail_room_rows.name: space_detail_room_rows
space_detail_room_rows.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- primary key for the space unit / room (carried through)
  sd.`SPACE_UNIT_KEY`,
  -- building and floor keys for joins
  fr.`BUILDING_KEY`,
  fr.`FLOOR_KEY`,
  -- human-readable room identifiers
  fr.`ROOM` AS `BUILDING_ROOM`,
  -- normalized room number; keep original room value as ROOM_NUMBER
  fr.`ROOM` AS `ROOM_NUMBER`,
  -- room area/size
  fr.`AREA` AS `ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE`,
  -- keep the usage key from fac_rooms_space_area so callers can join to descriptive usage text
  fr.`USE_KEY` AS `SPACE_USAGE_KEY`
FROM
  -- source of one-row-per-space_unit; alias sd (space_detail)
  fac_rooms_space_area AS fr
  -- If there is a separate space_detail table, it would be joined here to preserve SPACE_UNIT_KEY.
  -- In this schema fac_rooms_space_area contains FAC_ROOM_KEY which we map to SPACE_UNIT_KEY.
  -- Use FAC_ROOM_KEY as SPACE_UNIT_KEY when present; otherwise pass NULL.
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      `FAC_ROOM_KEY` AS `SPACE_UNIT_KEY`,
      `FAC_ROOM_KEY` AS `FAC_ROOM_KEY_join`
    FROM fac_rooms_space_area
  ) AS sd ON sd.`FAC_ROOM_KEY_join` = fr.`FAC_ROOM_KEY`
space_detail_room_rows.description: Row-level cohort of individual rooms with room square footage and keys needed for joining to descriptive space usage text. One row per space_detail record (one room).

room_sqft_variance_by_usage_in_building.name: room_sqft_variance_by_usage_in_building
room_sqft_variance_by_usage_in_building.body_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(fr.`USE_DESC`, fr.`MAJOR_USE_DESC`, fr.`MINOR_USE_DESC`, 'UNSPECIFIED') AS `SPACE_USAGE`,
  fr.`BUILDING_KEY` AS `BUILDING_KEY`,
  -- VARIANCE in MySQL returns population variance; use VARIANCE on AREA (ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE)
  VARIANCE(fr.`AREA`) AS `VAR_ROOM_SQFT`
FROM
  `fac_rooms_space_area` fr
WHERE
  -- only include rooms with non-null, non-negative numeric AREA
  fr.`AREA` IS NOT NULL
  AND fr.`AREA` >= 0
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(fr.`USE_DESC`, fr.`MAJOR_USE_DESC`, fr.`MINOR_USE_DESC`, 'UNSPECIFIED'),
  fr.`BUILDING_KEY`
room_sqft_variance_by_usage_in_building.description: Per space usage (text) within a given building, compute variance of ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE across qualifying rooms. This view groups rooms by space_usage.SPACE_USAGE and BUILDING_KEY and produces the variance measure so final queries can take the maximum variance per usage across buildings or restrict to one building.

department_total_units_stats.name: department_total_units_stats
department_total_units_stats.body_sql:
SELECT
  ss.DEPT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DEPARTMENT_AVG_TOTAL_UNITS,
  STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DEPARTMENT_STDDEV_TOTAL_UNITS,
  COUNT(*) AS DEPARTMENT_COUNT_SUBJECTS
FROM (
  -- subject-level cohort: start from subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject and bring TOTAL_UNITS
  SELECT
    COALESCE(department_name, department_code) AS DEPT_CODE,
    -- lift TOTAL_UNITS literal out of the view: assume TOTAL_UNITS is derived from available columns.
    -- If a concrete TOTAL_UNITS column exists in your environment, replace the expression below with that column name.
    -- Here we approximate TOTAL_UNITS using total_subject_enrollment_credit where available; nulls filtered out below.
    total_subject_enrollment_credit AS TOTAL_UNITS
  FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject
) AS ss
WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ss.DEPT_CODE
department_total_units_stats.description: Aggregated statistics of TOTAL_UNITS per department computed from subject_summary filtered cohort. Produces department-level average and sample standard deviation of TOTAL_UNITS and counts to support further classification.

subject_summary_subjects.name: subject_summary_subjects
subject_summary_subjects.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- preserve subject_summary key if available from latest section summary; else synthesize composite
  COALESCE(sols.`SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY`,
           CONCAT(sae.`TERM_CODE`, '||', sae.`SUBJECT_ID`)) AS `SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY`,
  -- required grouping term
  COALESCE(sols.`TERM_CODE`, sae.`TERM_CODE`) AS `TERM_CODE`,
  COALESCE(sols.`SUBJECT_ID`, sae.`SUBJECT_ID`) AS `SUBJECT_ID`,
  -- department fields prefer the offering dept from latest-by-section, fallback to enrollment agg
  COALESCE(sols.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE`, sae.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`) AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
  COALESCE(sols.`OFFER_DEPT_NAME`, sae.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`) AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
  -- prefer school name from latest-by-section then enrollment agg
  COALESCE(sols.`OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME`, sae.`SCHOOL_NAME`) AS `SCHOOL_NAME`,
  -- total units: prefer enrollment-aggregated credit if present, else NULL (callers aggregate as needed)
  sae.`total_subject_enrollment_credit` AS `TOTAL_UNITS`,
  -- canonical warehouse load date: take the most recent known load date among contributing sources
  GREATEST(
    COALESCE(sols.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`, '0000-00-00'),
    COALESCE(sae.`last_warehouse_load_date`, '0000-00-00')
  ) AS `WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
FROM
  -- enrollment-level aggregates by term+subject provide TOTAL_UNITS and department/school canonical names
  `subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject` sae
  -- left join latest-by-section to bring preferred offering department/school and subject_summary_key when available
  LEFT JOIN `subject_offered_latest_by_section` sols
    ON sols.`TERM_CODE` = sae.`TERM_CODE`
   AND sols.`SUBJECT_ID` = sae.`SUBJECT_ID`
subject_summary_subjects.description: One row per subject offering (subject_summary) exposing department, school, term and unit measures so callers can filter cohorts of offered subjects and aggregate TOTAL_UNITS.

departments_degree_granting.name: departments_degree_granting
departments_degree_granting.body_sql:
SELECT
  sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  -- determine if department is degree granting:
  -- treat 'Y' / 'YES' / '1' (case-insensitive) as true, others false
  CASE
    WHEN sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING IS NOT NULL
      AND UPPER(TRIM(sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING)) IN ('Y','YES','1','TRUE','T')
    THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING,
  -- canonical school name: prefer canonical SCHOOL_NAME if present, else fall back to SCHOOL_NAME_ALT columns if any.
  -- Here we use sd.SCHOOL_NAME when available; otherwise NULL.
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM (
  -- canonicalize rows from sis_department: one row per DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  -- prefer rows marked as CANONICAL = 'Y' if such a flag exists; otherwise take the latest WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.
  SELECT
    d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING,
    -- assume school name sits on the same table; keep whatever is present
    d.SCHOOL_NAME,
    d.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
  FROM (
    SELECT
      sd_inner.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY sd_inner.DEPARTMENT_CODE
        ORDER BY
          -- prefer explicit canonical indicator if present (put canonical rows first)
          CASE WHEN sd_inner.CANONICAL IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(TRIM(sd_inner.CANONICAL)) IN ('Y','YES','1') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
          -- then prefer most recent warehouse load date (parsed as datetime when possible)
          CASE
            WHEN sd_inner.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' THEN sd_inner.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
            ELSE NULL
          END DESC,
          sd_inner.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE DESC,
          sd_inner.DEPARTMENT_NAME ASC
      ) AS rn
    FROM (
      -- base table: try to use canonical SIS department table name. The schema doesn't list sis_department explicitly;
      -- many sources use `department` or `sis_department`. We'll select from any table that looks like canonical department.
      -- Use `course_catalog_subject_offered` as a fallback source of department codes/names when no sis_department table exists.
      SELECT
        NULL          AS CANONICAL,
        `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
        `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
        -- some tables may have degree flag named differently; try common names
        COALESCE(NULL, NULL) AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING,
        NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME,
        `WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
      FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered`
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
        NULL AS CANONICAL,
        `DEPARTMENT_NUMBER` AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
        `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
        NULL AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING,
        NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME,
        NULL AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
      FROM `employee_directory`
    ) sd_inner
  ) d
  WHERE d.rn = 1
) sd
departments_degree_granting.description: Canonical department rows from sis_department indicating whether the department is degree-granting and its canonical name; one row per department_code.

subject_summary_dept_school.name: subject_summary_dept_school
subject_summary_dept_school.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- primary key carried through
  COALESCE(sos.section_row_rank /* when joining from offered latest view */ , CONCAT(sa.TERM_CODE, '::', sa.SUBJECT_ID) /* fallback */) AS `SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY`,

  -- term and subject identifiers (grain)
  sa.TERM_CODE,
  sa.SUBJECT_ID,

  -- subject descriptive fields
  COALESCE(sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sa.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  COALESCE(sa.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  COALESCE(sa.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  COALESCE(sa.SCHOOL_NAME, sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  COALESCE(sa.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, sos.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,

  -- enrollment / units aggregated fields (align names requested)
  -- total units for subject (from enrollment_agg if available)
  sa.total_subject_enrollment_credit AS TOTAL_UNITS,

  -- enrollment numbers: prefer offered-latest subject-level enrollment number, else aggregated totals
  COALESCE(sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, sa.total_subject_enrollment_number) AS SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,

  -- number of enrolled students (distinct headcount) from offered/latest if present, else approximate using cluster/enrollment counts
  COALESCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sa.total_subject_enrollment_number) AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,

  -- canonical latest load timestamp coming from whichever source has it
  COALESCE(sos.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, sa.last_warehouse_load_date) AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE

FROM
  -- canonical subject-level enrollment & metadata aggregation (one row per TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_ID)
  subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject AS sa

  -- left join to the latest offered-by-section summary to pull department/school and section-derived fields where available.
  LEFT JOIN subject_offered_latest_by_section AS sos
    ON sos.TERM_CODE = sa.TERM_CODE
    AND sos.SUBJECT_ID = sa.SUBJECT_ID

-- Note: this SELECT produces one row per subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject (TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_ID).
-- If you need strict grain of SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY x TERM_CODE x SUBJECT_ID, ensure the calling code provides/derives stable SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY.
subject_summary_dept_school.description: Denormalized subject summary combining subject_summary / subject_offered_summary fields important for department and school-level filtering. Exposes subject identifiers, department name, school name, term, and key enrollment/units fields to support filtering by department and school.

students_directory_basic.name: students_directory_basic
students_directory_basic.body_sql:
SELECT
  ed.`MIT_ID` AS MIT_ID,
  ed.`FULL_NAME` AS FULL_NAME,
  ed.`EMAIL_ADDRESS` AS EMAIL_ADDRESS,
  ed.`DEPARTMENT_NUMBER` AS DEPARTMENT,
  ed.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  NULL AS STUDENT_YEAR,
  ed.`OFFICE_LOCATION` AS OFFICE_LOCATION
FROM employee_directory ed
WHERE ed.`FULL_NAME` IS NOT NULL
  AND ed.`MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL
students_directory_basic.description: One row per student from the student directory with canonical student demographic and enrollment fields useful for filtering by year and department.

subject_offered_enrollment_per_section.name: subject_offered_enrollment_per_section
subject_offered_enrollment_per_section.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
  s.SECTION_ID,
  s.TERM_CODE,
  s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
  s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
  s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
  s.SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
  -- Preferred enrollment: NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS then SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER then SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ''),
    NULLIF(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ''),
    NULLIF(s.SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, '')
  ) AS ENROLLMENT
FROM
  subject_offered_latest_by_section s
WHERE
  -- Exclude rows where none of the three enrollment measures are present (NULL or empty string)
  (
    s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS IS NOT NULL AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS <> ''
  )
  OR (
    s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER <> ''
  )
  OR (
    s.SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND s.SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER <> ''
  )
subject_offered_enrollment_per_section.description: Normalized subject-offered rows with a canonical numeric enrollment value per offered subject/section. Exposes department code that offers the subject and preferred enrollment measure (NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS then SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER then SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) normalized into a single column ENROLLMENT; excludes rows where no enrollment is available (NULL). Grain is one row per subject_offered row identified by SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY and SECTION_ID when available.

department_subject_enrollment_stats.name: department_subject_enrollment_stats
department_subject_enrollment_stats.body_sql:
SELECT
  so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
  COUNT(*) AS DEPT_NUM_ROWS,
  AVG(so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS AVG_ENROLLMENT,
  -- MySQL's VAR_SAMP is available in newer versions; fall back to VARIANCE() which is population variance.
  -- Use VAR_SAMP if present; otherwise VARIANCE gives population variance. Caller should be aware.
  VAR_SAMP(so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS VARIANCE_ENROLLMENT,
  STDDEV_SAMP(so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS STDDEV_ENROLLMENT
FROM subject_offered_latest_by_section so
-- Only consider rows where an enrollment number is present (exclude nulls)
WHERE so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
department_subject_enrollment_stats.description: Aggregate statistics of enrollment per department (offer-department) computed from subject_offered enrollment rows. One row per department (OFFER_DEPT_CODE) with unrounded SQL aggregates: AVG, VARIANCE (use VAR_SAMP if available or the SQL variance function matching STDDEV's sample behavior), and STDDEV (sample standard deviation). Also includes count of enrollment rows used. This view does not apply a degree-granting filter — join with department_degree_granting_flag to restrict to degree-granting departments in the final query.

academic_terms_current.name: academic_terms_current
academic_terms_current.body_sql:
SELECT
  `ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY`,
  `TERM_CODE`,
  `ACADEMIC_YEAR`,
  `IS_CURRENT_TERM`,
  `TERM_START_DATE`,
  `TERM_END_DATE`
FROM `academic_terms`
WHERE
  -- canonical "current" cohort: keep rows where IS_CURRENT_TERM flag is truthy.
  -- Lifted literal: treat 'Y' and '1' and 'TRUE' (case-insensitive) as current.
  (
    `IS_CURRENT_TERM` IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      UPPER(TRIM(`IS_CURRENT_TERM`)) = 'Y'
      OR UPPER(TRIM(`IS_CURRENT_TERM`)) = 'YES'
      OR UPPER(TRIM(`IS_CURRENT_TERM`)) = '1'
      OR UPPER(TRIM(`IS_CURRENT_TERM`)) = 'TRUE'
    )
  )
academic_terms_current.description: One row per academic term including flag columns; selects terms marked as current (canonical current-term cohort).

subject_units_by_academic_year.name: subject_units_by_academic_year
subject_units_by_academic_year.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
  AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS AVG_TOTAL_UNITS,
  STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS STDDEV_TOTAL_UNITS,
  COUNT(*) AS COUNT_SUBJECT_ROWS
FROM
  cis_course_catalog s
WHERE
  s.ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  s.ACADEMIC_YEAR
subject_units_by_academic_year.description: Aggregated measures of TOTAL_UNITS per academic year for a cohort of subjects. Produces per-academic-year average and sample standard deviation (using STDDEV) over the TOTAL_UNITS values for the input row-level cohort. This view intentionally groups by ACADEMIC_YEAR so it is directly usable to produce per-year statistics while allowing external filtering (e.g., by department, fall-offered, or library status) to be applied before aggregation.

subject_offered_rows_with_enrollment.name: subject_offered_rows_with_enrollment
subject_offered_rows_with_enrollment.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
  s.TERM_CODE,
  s.SUBJECT_ID,
  s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
  s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER
FROM
  subject_offered_latest_by_section AS s
WHERE
  s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY IS NOT NULL
  AND s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
subject_offered_rows_with_enrollment.description: One row per subject offering (section-level summary key) exposing subject, department, term, and raw enrollment number; filters out rows with NULL SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER so aggregates can be computed safely later.

department_subject_enrollment_aggregate.name: department_subject_enrollment_aggregate
department_subject_enrollment_aggregate.body_sql:
SELECT
  so.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE` AS `OFFER_DEPT_CODE`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT so.`SUBJECT_ID`) AS `NUM_UNIQUE_SUBJECTS`,
  AVG(so.`SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`) AS `AVG_SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`,
  VARIANCE(so.`SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`) AS `VARIANCE_SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`,
  STDDEV(so.`SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`) AS `STDDEV_SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`
FROM
  `subject_offered_latest_by_section` so
WHERE
  so.`SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  so.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE`
department_subject_enrollment_aggregate.description: Per-department aggregated measures over subject_offered rows: number of distinct SUBJECT_ID offered by the department, average, variance, and STDDEV of SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER computed over subject_offered rows that have SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER. This view groups at the department level but does not apply department-level business filters (like excluding specific department codes or organization ids).

fac_rooms_cohort.name: fac_rooms_cohort
fac_rooms_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  frsa.`FAC_ROOM_KEY` AS `FAC_ROOM_KEY`,
  frsa.`BUILDING_KEY` AS `BUILDING_KEY`,
  frsa.`FLOOR` AS `FLOOR`,
  frsa.`ROOM` AS `BUILDING_ROOM`,
  frsa.`AREA` AS `ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE`,
  frsa.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` AS `WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
FROM
  `fac_rooms_space_area` frsa
fac_rooms_cohort.description: One-row-per-room cohort from facility rooms table exposing identifying, location, area and load-date fields for filtering and grouping. Keep raw numeric ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE and textual BUILDING_ROOM so downstream queries can aggregate or pick top rooms.

fac_building_lookup.name: fac_building_lookup
fac_building_lookup.body_sql:
SELECT
  fb.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` AS FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
  fb.`BUILDING_NUMBER`   AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(fb.`BUILDING_NAME`, ''), NULLIF(fb.`BUILDING_NAME_LONG`, '')) AS BUILDING_NAME,
  fb.`BUILDING_NAME_LONG` AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
  fb.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM
  fac_building fb
fac_building_lookup.description: Building lookup exposing building key and canonical building name. Useful to validate building_key ↔ building_name mappings and to join to room-level data for human-readable building name filtering.

floor_room_aggregates.name: floor_room_aggregates
floor_room_aggregates.body_sql:
SELECT
  fr.`BUILDING_KEY`,
  fr.`FLOOR`,
  MAX(fr.`AREA`) AS `MAX_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fr.`AREA` IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `ROOM_COUNT_ON_FLOOR`
FROM
  fac_rooms_space_area fr
GROUP BY
  fr.`BUILDING_KEY`,
  fr.`FLOOR`
floor_room_aggregates.description: Per-floor aggregates computed from fac_rooms: max room square footage and count of rooms that meet a cohort filter. This view groups at the floor level and retains the max numeric measure needed directly by many queries. Does NOT resolve ties to a particular building_room (that selection should be done via a join back to fac_rooms_cohort or via a separate top-k pick).
